title: Tables of composition and nutritional values of feed materials (INRAE, CIRAD, AFZ, FAO)
notes: Curated compilation of published analyses. Every table gives mean, SD, min, max and n. Values marked with an asterisk are PREDICTED from equations, not measured - carried through on the `predicted` column by reviewer decision 2026-09-09.

title: Phyllis2 - database for the physico-chemical composition of (treated) lignocellulosic biomass
notes: Each record cites its own literature reference, so provenance resolves to a paper rather than to the database. Fuel-oriented parameter set: proximate, ultimate CHONS, Cl, LHV/HHV, ash oxides - no Weende and no Van Soest fibre. SIBLING-FRACTION RECORDS EXIST AND ARE DELIBERATELY NOT USED (2026-09-10). Phyllis2 files records for a crop's individual fractions beside records for the whole residue: under maize it holds corn stover (7), corn stalks (6), corn cob (11), maize leaf and maize shoots. That is a consequence of what each submitter happened to analyse, not a classification - and maize and corn are the same plant, British and American English, not two materials. Only the STOVER records feed a whole-residue object; a stalk-only or cob-only analysis on `mais-stro` would be the same error as potato composition on potato peel. The fraction records stay useful: if the register ever distinguishes a maize fraction as its own object, the data is already there.
